description: Source code for the Python RPC handler in PyTorch's distributed RPC framework, including initialization, cleanup, and type resolution functionalities.

classes.name: PythonTypeResolver
classes.description: Resolver for Python types, supporting resolving 'PyObject' and other type names via the JIT compilation unit.

methods.name: init
methods.description: Initializes the Python RPC handler by importing necessary Python modules and setting function pointers.

methods.name: cleanup
methods.description: Cleans up references to Python objects and resets internal state.

methods.name: getInstance
methods.description: Returns a singleton instance of PythonRpcHandler, ensuring thread safety and proper GIL handling.

methods.name: jitCompilationUnit
methods.description: Returns the JIT compilation unit associated with the handler.

methods.name: runPythonUdf
methods.description: Executes a Python user-defined function within the RPC context.

methods.name: serialize
methods.description: Serializes a Python object into a payload and tensors.

methods.name: deserialize
methods.description: Deserializes a payload and tensors back into a Python object.

methods.name: handleException
methods.description: Handles exceptions raised during Python RPC calls.

methods.name: handleExceptionGILHeld
methods.description: Handles exceptions with the GIL held, ensuring thread safety.

methods.name: isRemoteException
methods.description: Checks if a given Python object is a RemoteException.

methods.name: parseTypeFromStr
methods.description: Parses a type from its string representation.

methods.name: getRRefProxyFunctions
methods.description: Returns functions related to RRef proxies.

methods.name: getRRefTypeFunctions
methods.description: Returns functions related to RRef types.
